title: Unit Event — Chasing The Sparkle Beyond the Blue Sky

meta.Event: Chasing The Sparkle Beyond the Blue Sky
meta.Outline: Feeling the need for further practice leading up to their solo show, MORE MORE JUMP! decide to do a training camp that doubles as a streaming project. They start doing a variety of exercises under a special program devised by Airi, but something seems to be worrying Minori...

rows.Line: We'd rather not have our first solo show leave a bad impression on everyone.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: We plan to hire a staff to help us on the day of, but after much discussion, we decided to do things on a scale that allows everyone to see what we're doing.

rows.Line:

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: What if we can't even get 700 people to gather? The possibility of that happening isn't zero, which is a big concern since it'll definitely put us in the red.

rows.Line:

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Because we should be doing everything we can to get as many people as possible to become fans of MORE MORE JUMP!

rows.Line: Airi...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:

rows.Speaker: Airi

rows.Speaker: Airi

rows.Line: Wait, really?! Thank you so much!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. Then, we'll see you in a bit.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Whoa... The ocean looks so pretty when you're this close.>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Oh, that's right.
You guys haven't really had a chance to soak in the scenery yet.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: <Yes, it's nice to stop for a moment to actually do that. If I were over there with all of you, I'd probably have dived into the water already to celebrate how summery it is.>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
I definitely understand how you feel.
Yes, we got to ride on that banana boat, but we haven't really gone swimming yet.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Well, to be fair, Minori and I got to after going for a dunk during our turns...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Oh, you're right...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: <No fair! You and Minori got to go swimming!>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I kinda doubt going for a relaxing swim was on Minori's mind at that time.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Especially since she was doing everything in her power to succeed.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Right. And now, she's probably working on everything we just mentioned about our dance routine.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: <Are you sure she's not pushing herself too hard...?>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Yeah, I get how you feel.
I mean, it's her very first solo show and it's just around the corner.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: <Oh, right. Out of all of you girls, Minori's the only one who hasn't done a show like that before...>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Exactly. And it's going to be a very special moment for her since your first time only happens once during your life...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: On top of that, Minori's lifelong wish has been to become an idol, so this is her dream stage.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
<Right...
And performing in a solo show is one of the most significant milestones for a new idol.>

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <As such, I suppose it's only natural for her to want all the hard work she's put in up to this point to bear fruit.>

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: That reminds me of my first solo show. I remember how my heart began pounding so hard when I stood on stage that I was worried others would hear it...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Me too.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: However, I also remember having a strong desire to sing and dance in a way that made it so everyone in the audience enjoyed the show.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Yeah, totally!
It's really hard to put that feeling into words, but it's completely unforgettable.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
(Talk about a blast from the past...
I remember being so focused on making sure our show succeeded that I'd stay late to practice every single day.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (After we were done practicing as a group, I kept working on stuff, checking how I looked in the mirror and making fine adjustments because I'd convinced myself that absolutely no mistakes would be allowed.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
(So...
Minori's probably feeling the same way right now.)

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: <Airi?>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Sorry, guys...
On second thought, I'm gonna go check up on Minori! I'm sorta worried about her!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: A-Airi...?!
Beach

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Okay, let's see how Minori's...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huff... Huff...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Careful of what your fingertips do... Stretch out your arm like you're about to pluck the sun out of the sky...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Hmm... I'm still not getting it right...
Is it because of how I'm moving my arm?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Haruka made it look so pretty, but it feels so clunky whenever I try to do what she did...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Oh, she's still worried about the part during the chorus...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Out of all of us, she really has the best work ethic...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Okay, one more time...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hey, Minori. Working hard?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Huh?! Airi?!
You're back already?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I got a bit worried, came back to check and saw that you were practicing...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Y-Yeah...
It's our very first solo show, so I really don't want to disappoint everyone who's coming to see us.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: So, I thought that I should do everything I can to prevent that!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh, I know!
Would you mind taking a look at this part, Airi? It's been giving me a lot of trouble.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Also, if you could tell me about anything else you think seems off...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Sure, but...
You know I can be pretty tough, right?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Y-Yes, I know! I'm prepared for anything!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Hehe. In that case...
Show me!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: And lock my arm into place...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
(Yeah, not bad...
Her arm's in a nice, visible position. Must be because she worked on it so much on her own.)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Next, move like water flowing along...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (This is the part she's worried about the most. When we're supposed to stretch our arms up towards the sky during the chorus...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Huh? What she just did. It looked like...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Like this?
I'm trying to stretch my arm out more and more...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
So, that's where I'm at...
How'd it look?! Did I do okay?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Well, you have everything down in terms of the actual dance routine...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I do?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But your presentation leaves a lot to be desired.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: What?!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
But...
I thought I had it right...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I'll give you that you've been working really hard, Minori. You've been trying to figure out what you're doing different as your dance and make changes accordingly, which is admirable.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: However, just copying what we do isn't always the right answer.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh...? Copying what you do...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Ah, you must've been doing it subconsciously.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Regardless, you seem to be heavily influenced by the way Haruka dances...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: J-Just now, I thought about how pretty Haruka looks when she does that part...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Oh, you...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You're just like me when I was just starting out.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh? Like you, Airi...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Does that mean you've also tried copying others?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, but in my case, I did it deliberately.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Really...?!
That must mean you were trying to copy someone who was really good.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Actually...
I'm not so sure about that.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: If anything, I might've been the better one at singing and dancing.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Huh?
Then, why did you...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Probably because she possessed something that I didn't...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Something that you didn't possess...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Yeah, for the longest time...
I always wanted to be an idol who shined on stage.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But that was when I'd just become a trainee...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
I thought I'd punched my ticket...
I got an audition to become an idol trainee and believed I was on my way towards achieving my dream.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I ultimately passed and began thinking, “Just watch! I'm gonna become the best idol!” Then, everyone started paying attention to this other girl.

rows.Speaker: Photographer
rows.Line:
Okay, that should do it.
This one looks really nice.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Thank you very much.
I'll be looking forward to working with you again!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (I had no idea that you took promo pics like this...!)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (I practiced in front of the mirror a ton last night, so I sure hope it did turn out okay. As much as I'd like to ask, a rookie like me probably isn't in any position to...)

rows.Speaker: Young Staff Member
rows.Line: Did you hear about the girl that won the Grand Prix for the Cheerful * Days audition? The one for their third generation.

rows.Speaker: Mid-level Staff Member
rows.Line:
Heard and saw.
She's absolutely gorgeous and has this amazing aura about her. I have a feeling that she's going to get to do some modeling or acting work on top of being an idol.

rows.Speaker: Young Staff Member
rows.Line:
You think so too?!
She's doing a shoot here tomorrow, right? I can't wait to meet her.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Oh, I knew that they were auditioning, but didn't realize someone like her had won...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Cheerful * Days is this agency's flagship group, so winning the Grand Prix has to mean that she's out of this world...)

rows.Speaker: Female Staff Member
rows.Line: Hey, did you see that girl from Cheerful * Days? Grand Prix winners just have this thing, you know? I mean, she was head and shoulders above all the other trainees!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Today's shoot was supposed to be about the trainees... And yet, all this commotion about...)

rows.Speaker: New Staff Member
rows.Line:
Shizuku Hinomori, right?
I made sure to immediately memorize her name after I heard the news! I'd also love to meet her, but do you think she's still here...?

rows.Speaker: Female Staff Member
rows.Line: She's still practicing at the theater, so you should still be able to see her. I'm sure you'll know who she is just by her incredible aura!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Oh, the theater's just right there...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (If we're both aiming for the top, we'll probably end up becoming rivals. Also, if she's garnering this much attention already, I should try seeing her at least once.)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Alright, in that case...!)
Cheerful * Days Theater

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Here I am...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
(Are they taking a break right now?
I ended up deciding to sneak in for a quick look, but where is this Hinomori girl...?)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Is that the girl who won...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Whoa... It's hard to believe someone like her even exists...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
(It's like she's radiating with beauty...
She really is nothing like the others...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Can I really make it...?)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Is it possible for me to survive in a world with people like her in it...?)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (No, this is day one. Why am I being so negative?)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (This isn't about if I can or can't make it...)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Being an idol is all about having heart!)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: There you are! You must be Shizuku Hinomori! The winner of the Grand Prix for that audition, right?
Beach

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: You went through the same thing, Airi...?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I honestly couldn't believe it myself. I always found my eyes gravitating towards her on their own.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Some people are just born with that sort of talent and power.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Yeah...
Shizuku... And Haruka...
It's like everything they do makes them sparkle.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Yeah.
Haruka also possesses that power.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
But back then...
I believe something other than having an aura, natural talent or great looks was more important to being an idol.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Which is how I ended up convincing myself that I had to see Shizuku and others like her as my rivals. I couldn't lose to her...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: And I gave every single job absolutely everything I had in order to prove a point. To show that it's important for idols to have heart.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wow, Airi, that totally sounds like what you'd do!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Unfortunately, things didn't work out for me. No matter how hard I tried, our agency kept giving Shizuku all the attention, and her fan base grew and grew...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I mean, we're talking about someone who literally received three truckloads of chocolates for White Day! If that's not legendary, what is?!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Th-Three truckloads?!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: It definitely sounds like something that'd happen to Shizuku...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Of course, that happened because Shizuku also put in the work.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: As for me, until I became a select member of QT, I wasn't really rewarded for my hard work. Even though I did more than anyone else to get my name out there.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Then, I saw Shizuku appearing on TV. That was when I realized how heart alone wouldn't be enough. I realized that you need to possess the ability to dazzle people.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Airi...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Which was when I decided to switch things up by trying to figure out how to do that, like practicing putting on cuter makeup looks, changing my usual diet and throwing in a little strength training...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Be it fashion or cosmetics, I tested out whatever I could in order to give myself that ability to dazzle and awe...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Then it dawned on me. I can go my own way...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Your own way...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah. For example, Minori, you and I are pretty similar in the sense that neither of us is all that stylish, and we don't have that aura that Shizuku and Haruka do.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Guh...
I don't think you lack either of those things, Airi, but I certainly do...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. I appreciate the compliment, but you don't have to try to cheer me up. Also, don't put yourself down like that.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Because I'm gonna show you a trick right now that's gonna make you look unbelievably cute!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: R-Really?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Yeah, really.
First, start by pretending this beach is a concert venue and you're about to smile for all your fans.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Pretend this beach is a concert venue... And smile... Uhh, so...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Like this?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Is that all you got...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh?!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: U-Um... What if I greeted them and gave a little bow...? Or... I can... Uhh...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: At this rate, your smile's only gonna reach the people at the front.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh, you're right...!
I have to make it so it reaches everyone here...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Exactly.
So, with that in mind, go ahead and give it another try!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
First, get a good picture in your head.
This venue's packed from wall to wall.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: This venue's packed from wall to wall...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Then, you hear some people on the second deck shouting something after going all out for a big dance routine.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: How would you reply to them in that situation...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
The second deck...?
I-I'd...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
I can hear you!
Thank you all so much!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, that's it!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
*Gasp*
My hands! The way I waved them just now...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Precisely.
You waved them differently, right?
It's clear that you wanted them to hear you.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
And it wasn't just your hands.
You even went on your tippy-toes for a split second during your delivery to make certain that you reached them. Did you notice...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, now that you mention it...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: It was really just for a split second, but it's a great expression of who you are, Minori. A girl with an amazing work ethic and a ton of energy! It makes me want to see more of you!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
S-See more of me...?!
They'll really think that...?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Hehe. That's right.
And this isn't the only way. There's plenty more where that came from.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: For instance, it's not just about how you appear on stage. The little things you do as you dance and stuff also matter a lot.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yes, everyone's eyes tend to gravitate towards the people who exude a brilliant aura, but there's a way to redraw their attention.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: H-How?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You just gotta be honest and show everybody that you want to be seen.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: That I want to be seen...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, wait. Sort of like what I just did? I wasn't quite trying to be “seen”. More like “noticed”.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: That's exactly what I'm talking about!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: It's less important to show and tell, so to speak, than it is to communicate with your audience. What you did just a second ago is a good example of that, Minori.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: What to do when you make eye contact with someone in the crowd while dancing also comes to mind. Knowing how to deal with those kinds of situations can also make a big difference.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
While dancing...?
My eyes usually hover around the seats in the back, but I guess I don't actually look at anyone, huh?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: What do you usually do, Airi?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Well...
I usually wink whenever I make eye contact with someone.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: It's my way of thanking them for looking towards me!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
*Gasp*
If my favorite idol ever did that for me...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. It's like an arrow through your heart, right?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: It's the best feeling in the world. And after that, you just gotta dance like you mean it!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Yeah...!
So that's what you meant by communicating with the audience.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Yup.
For our first example, Minori, all you did was smile a little while looking straight forward.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But when you thought about reaching the people on the second deck, you lifted your chin and stuff to make sure they heard you, no?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: And they're looking right back at you...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh, right.
So if I want my smile to reach everyone in the crowd...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Yeah!
That's really cute!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: You're guaranteed to get everyone's attention now!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehe... I did a good job.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
So, think you got it...?
This is “my way”...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: A way that lets even idols that don't have much of an aura really shine!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah, you gave such a great explanation! It's so amazing how you came up with this all on your own, Airi...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh! But...
Is it okay for someone like me to learn about such an incredible trick...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Of course it is.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I mean, if teaching you a little trick like this leads to you becoming even cuter, then I couldn't be happier.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Airi...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: At the same time, how you present yourself can also change based on the kind of message you want to send your audience, as well as what sort of idol you want to become.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: So, it's best not to see this conversation as the end-all-be-all with regards to being an idol. Moving forward, Minori, I want you to discover the best way for you to shine.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: The best way for me to shine...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Okay...!
I'll take what I learned from you today, Airi, and keep trying more and more!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. And I'll be right there with you!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: It looks like Airi's advice worked...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Yeah.
You were right, Shizuku. I'm glad we let Airi take care of this.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
<Hehe...
Now I'm really looking forward to seeing your show.>
A few hours later
Beach

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Thank you all for watching!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: That concludes the second half of our training stream!

rows.Line:
<I can't believe how much your dancing improved!>
<I'm so excited about your solo show now!>

rows.Line: Hehe. Well, we may or may not be doing a surprise night stream later on, so stay tuned!

rows.Line:

<Please archive this!>
<^^^ They said they'd archive everything a little earlier.>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: And a special thanks to all those who stayed with us in real time for the whole stream.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
We'll see you guys again real soon.
Until then, everyone...

rows.Speaker: Airi, Haruka, Minori & Shizuku
rows.Line: Good night!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Nice work, everyone! The second half went really well...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: It wasn't easy, but I'm glad we all hung in there until the end.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Me too!
However, after working out and doing stuff all day... I'm exhausted...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. Then, let's start recovering by taking a nice dip in the hot springs.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Oh, yes!
I've been looking forward to that ever since I heard that they had them here!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Alright, you can all go on ahead without me. I'm gonna stay here and take a look around.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Is there something you need to do?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
I'm just going for a walk.
This might be my only chance to go for a stroll along the beach at night, you know?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Okay...
In that case, we'll go on ahead without you.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Sure thing!
Have fun at the hot springs!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Yeah...
This is nice. The sea seems so much more mysterious at night.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
And this breeze feels really great...
It might've been fun to play with some fireworks during our stream...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Airi!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Hm?
I thought you went to the hot springs with the others.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Yes, I was...
But I felt like joining you after you said you'd be going for a walk.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Hehe. Uh, okay?
As long as you're fine with that, I guess.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Still, isn't this a beautiful view...?
What we saw at dusk was also nice, but I really love seeing the sea at night.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Yes, so do I.
I have a feeling that more than a few people would really enjoy it if we were to stream what we're seeing now...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Hey, I was just thinking the same thing!
Let's see what Haruka and Minori think once they get back from the hot springs!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Okay!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Also, I can't believe how well our stream went. We made it into the rankings for something, right?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, I couldn't believe it either. It was only for a second, but we flew up the charts for our streaming platform!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. We have you to thank for picking out where we'd be staying and coming up with all these fun training activities, Airi.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I appreciate it, but I really didn't do anything all that special. Our stream did so well because all of you made it so.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: As far as training goes, it probably felt good in the end because you all made a real effort.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Yes, we all put in a great effort!
